title: Probabilistic query
description: What to compute on one compiled BN. Interventions (rows, parameters, parameter_sets) set the scenario, do()-style; targets and events say what to report. Evidence is part of the language but refused: the engine is forward-only.

targets.description: Node ids to summarise, "<Quantity>::<row id>"; * matches any run of characters, e.g. TravelTime::*>n22.

events.description: Probabilities of threshold events, one per matching node. A discrete node compares by state order, and == / != against a state.

rows.description: do(): set fixed data of rows, {"<row id>": {"<attribute>": value}}, e.g. an Event's magnitude.

parameters.description: do(): override inline parameters of a bound function, {"<function id>": {"<name>": value}}.

parameter_sets.description: do(): bind another parameter set to a function, {"<function id>": "<parameter-set id>"}.

evidence.description: Observed node values. Refused: forward inference only.
